notes: No precedent in project; fresh Rule 2 sweep not needed -- direct fetch worked cleanly on home page, robots.txt, nav, and all /collections/<handle>/products.json endpoints (HTTP 200 throughout, no WAF/challenge). robots.txt carries no Claude-specific disallow (checked for ClaudeBot/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot/Claude-Web/GPTBot/anthropic tokens -- none present, only standard admin/cart/checkout/search disallows). Platform: Shopify. Every qty below is an EXHAUSTION-VERIFIED unique-product-ID count via paged /collections/<handle>/products.json (limit=250), not the storefront's own displayed/collections.json total -- collections.json counts proved inflated by 1.3x-3x across the board (e.g. Decor listed 517 vs 197 actual, Mirrors listed 72 vs 43 actual, Lamps listed 189 vs 91 actual, Canvas & Framed Wall Art listed 396 vs 168 actual, Junior Lighting listed 49 vs 23 actual), consistent with this project's 'Shopify products_count is unreliable' precedent. Several genuine site collections are mixed roll-ups; titles were inspected and non-conforming SKUs dropped (not padded) per project rule: 'Decor' (197 unique) contained 38 Home Fragrance SKUs (Aroma Lab/Quiet Ritual/Green Tea/Fresh Linen scented candles, diffusers, room sprays, hand soap/lotion) -> reported as 159; 'Junior Decorative Accessories' (31 unique) contained 19 hamper/waste-bin/money-bank/artificial-floral SKUs -> reported as 12; 'Wall Decorations' (20 unique) contained 3 wall shelves (storage furniture) -> reported as 17; 'Junior Wall Decor & Mirrors' (21 unique) split into 7 mirrors + 9 wall-art/decor, 5 wall shelves dropped. Rule 0 gains: Junior & Baby and Outdoor branches were fully traversed for lighting/mirrors/wall-decor despite non-room/non-adult naming -- Junior Lighting (dedicated site collection, 23), Junior Wall Decor (9) + Junior Mirrors (7) split from the site's combined Junior Wall Decor & Mirrors collection, Junior Decorative Accessories (12); Baby has NO dedicated lighting/mirror/wall-decor collection, so its 35-SKU flat product list was hand-classified by title (exhaustion-verified, not estimated): 5 lighting, 1 mirror, 4 wall-decor, rest textile/storage/novelty -- reported as three small rows since no single site URL matches these counts exactly (evidence documents the manual classification). Outdoor: the site's own 'Outdoor Lighting & Candles' collection undercounts (only 3 SKUs tagged) vs. 10 genuine lantern/string-light/solar-lamp SKUs found in the full 84-SKU Outdoor product list -- reported 10 with the fuller list as evidence source; the remaining ~74 Outdoor SKUs are furniture/rugs/pillows/table-linens and excluded. Curtain Accessories & Hardware (74, exhaustion-verified) is reported IN FULL -- rods, brackets, holdbacks/tiebacks, rings, decorative poles are explicitly in-scope decorative metal hardware per brief, no contamination found. EXCLUDED entirely (checked, not extracted): Bedroom Decor (217 unique -- 100% textiles: pillows/cushions/throws/duvets/sheet sets/coverlets, zero lighting/mirror/wall-art content); Bathroom Decor (121 unique -- dominated by bath mats/towels/shower curtains (textile), hampers/storage baskets (storage), toilet-paper holders/toothbrush holders/soap dispensers (bath fixtures); the handful of genuine items -- 1 vanity mirror, 3 wall-art pieces, 1 set of wall hooks -- are negligible (~4%) and of a kind already captured under Mirrors/Wall Decorations/Canvas & Framed Wall Art); Kitchen Decor (110 unique) and Dinnerware (101 unique) -- these two nominally-distinct nav collections have 88% mutual product-ID overlap (Rule 0.6 facet-recut relationship) and both are dominated (~85%) by table linens (runners/placemats/tablecloths/napkins) and kitchen tools/storage (soap dispensers, jars, chair pads, bread boxes, paper-towel holders); genuine plate/bowl 'dinnerware' is a small (~7 SKU) fraction already effectively covered by decorative bowls/trays elsewhere, so neither node was extracted; Rugs, Throw Pillows & Throw Blankets, Curtains, Window Blinds & Shades, Greenery & Florals (artificial plants/flowers), Home Fragrances/Bouclair Fragrances, Smart Styles (furniture/cushions/curtains), Outdoor Furniture/Outdoor Rugs/Throw Pillows & Chair Pads, all Furniture branches, New/Sale/Clearance/Shop All (never-extract facet/promo pages). 'By Room' (Bedroom/Living Room/Kitchen & Dining, under /pages/by-room) collections are confirmed EMPTY (0 products via products.json on all three) -- a retired/inactive campaign page per Rule 3, not extractable, not a real competing room-tree so no Rule 0.6 overlap concern. No duplicate-company flag for S.N. 241 in this window's roster.
